popScale.$description: Pop: peak swell as a checkbox is checked.

settleScale.$description: Pop and Jelly: brief undershoot before settling.

jellyWide.$description: Jelly: how wide the box squashes.

jellyTall.$description: Jelly: how short the box squashes (and the reverse).

glyphOvershoot.$description: Pop and Fill: how large the tick or dash grows (times A1's glyph size) before settling.

pulse.$description: Pulse: how far the ring spreads from the box.

slide.$description: Slide: how far the tick or dash travels in or out.

flipAngle.$description: Flip: the box turns edge-on and back as it changes.
